messages:
Anya (product-marketing): Need a field-ready one-pager for Mar webinar (security + SLAs + deploy-mode decision guide + tiny benchmark). SDRs and speakers should be able to use it. EOD Friday target.
Mike G (growth): Can we also include 2 LinkedIn variants for AB testing and routing rules for inbound leads by deploy-mode?
Sophia (solutions): I'll map top security asks to deploy modes: data residency -> Private, KMS/HSM -> Dedicated/Private, audit logs -> all modes. Also will draft SLA tier copy.
Rohit (eng): I can add a conservative perf blurb: "H100 Dedicated shows ~1.8x throughput vs A100 at 2k seq in our pilot". I'll include tokens/sec and p50/p95 numbers in a tiny table.
Olivia (design): Layout plan: left = pain bullets, center = deploy-mode decision flow, right = benchmark + routing snippet. Two colorways for field. Need final copy Thu noon to ship PDF.
Anya (product-marketing): For the hero line we need exactly ~20 words. Draft: "Redwood Inference: unified, predictable and cost-efficient LLM serving with enterprise SLAs and flexible deployment modes for regulated workloads."
Mike G (growth): Routing rules idea (pseudo for Intercom/CRM):
```
if lead.tags contains "private" or lead.size > 500 -> assign: "SDR-enterprise";
if message.text contains "SLA" -> tag: "sla-escalation" -> assign: "AE";
else -> assign: "product-nurture";
```
Use deploy-interest tag to decide initial path.
Sophia (solutions): SLA tiers (aspirational): Standard: 99.5% uptime, p50 ~100ms; Premium: 99.95%, p50 ~50ms; Enterprise: 99.99%, p50 ~30ms. Note: depends on committed capacity.
Rohit (eng): Benchmark blurb for one-pager: "In internal tests and a pilot, dedicated pools with KV caching and mixed precision delivered ~40% lower per-token cost and 1.6-1.8x throughput on H100 vs A100 for 2k-seq workloads. Sequencing: batch size 8-16, warm KV cache, model family: LLaMA-like 33B variant." Keep claims qualified.
Anya (product-marketing): Good. Add a 1-sentence customer outcome line and use Sophia's anonymized pilot quote: "we cut inference cost by ~45% in steady-state workloads" (anonymized).
Olivia (design): Placeholder for quick quote added. Also need two short LinkedIn posts (<=280 chars).
Mike G (growth): Drafts below — keep two distinct hooks.
Variant A (product-led): "Predictable, cost-efficient LLM serving: Redwood Inference reduces per-token costs with caching, batching, and smart routing. Learn results from our pilot and pick the deploy mode that fits your security and SLA needs. Join our Mar 28 webinar. #LLM #inference"
Variant B (security/SLA-first): "Building regulated AI? Redwood Inference provides enterprise SLAs, private deployment options, and KMS/HSM integrations so you can ship securely. See benchmarked TCO wins and deployment decision guidance at our Mar 28 webinar. #security #AI"
Sophia (solutions): For field use, add a 3-bullet security checklist on the one-pager: 1) Data residency & VPC peering options, 2) KMS/HSM + BYOK, 3) Immutable audit logs + SIEM hooks.
Anya (product-marketing): Include a tiny "what we tested" note under benchmark: seq length 2048, batch 8-16, model family LLaMA-like 33B, warm KV cache. Cite internal tests + pilot customer.
Rohit (eng): I'll add a small perf table snippet for the right column: H100 Dedicated: throughput X tps, p50 Yms, p95 Zms; A100 Dedicated: throughput ~0.55x H100; Hosted: conservative numbers, note multi-tenant variance.
Mike G (growth): For routing in HubSpot/Intercom, tag leads by deploy interest on form and pipe to the right sequence. CTA in hosted flows -> product trial; Dedicated/Private -> AE outreach. SLA questions -> immediate AE.
Olivia (design): Will produce two colorways and a PDF export. Can we lock copy Thu noon?
Anya (product-marketing): Yes. Thanks team. I'll assemble and drop to #sales-review by EOD Friday.
marketing-bot: Reminder: Webinar "Secure Serving: Deploy Modes & SLAs" Mar 28 — RSVP closes in 48h.
